## Description {#details}

<p>Doubly linked lists classes.</p>


<p>Traditional doubly linked or low-intrusive doubly linked lists are provided for use cases where a fully intrusive approach is not required. These classes and templates offer a straightforward way to manage collections of objects using the classic doubly linked list structure.</p>


<p>For simpler use cases, such as traditional lists or low-intrusive lists, there are several simpler classes and templates available.</p>
